title: Badge
description: Highlight statuses or counts with compact labels

body.raw:
<BadgePreview />

##### Installation

<Code language="bash" code={`npx radianos add badge`} />

##### Imports

<Code language="tsx" code={`import {Badge} from "@/components/ui/Badge"`} />

##### Props

| Prop Name | Default Values | Values         |
| --------- | -------------- | -------------- |
| size      | 24             | 20, 24, 28, 32 |
| variant   | outline        | outline,strong |
| rounded   | false          | true/false     |
| closable  | false          | true/false     |

##### Usage

<Code
	language="tsx"
	code={`<Badge variant="strong" size="24" rounded={false}>
 Badge Example
 </Badge>
 `}
/>
